title: Eegdota Midhaan Iccitii
intro: Lafa magariisaa keessatti gareen namoota dhuunfaa dukkana jalatti haguuganii karoora dhoksaa baasan. Kaayyoo waloo kan qaban yoo ta’u, akeekni isaanii garuu qajeelummaa irraa fagoo ture. Yeroo rafan marsaan waaqummaa akka isaan eegu hin beekan turan.
clues: Karoorri keenya mudaa kan hin qabne jennee murtoo cimaa goone.
Namoonni kaan illee osoo hin sochoosin, dafnee baʼuuf yaadne.
Rizqii keenyatti ofitti amanamummaadhaan lafa lalisaa tokkorra kaane.
Bakka deemnu yommuu geenyu, gogaa fi lafa onaa taʼee waan argamneef, karaa dhabne nutti fakkaate.
Sana booda dhuguma bakka keenya ta'uu hubanne, kasaaraa keenyaaf wal komachaa abdii kutannee iyye.
Ganama sana hiyyeessa midhaan keenya keessaa baasuuf kakannee turre, garuu adabbiin Rabbii osoo rafnu nutti dhufee, maasii keenya gara diigamaatti jijjiire.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
